title.text: Take a peek · What arrives at your door

behaviour.text:
How it behaves

• One circle: the 1-second clip from the start of the video, silent, looping on its own, with a small play badge.

• Click (or tap) opens the modal: the full 21 s video, no sound, plays once, with a pause button. Esc, the X or a click outside closes it.

• Under the video: 'What arrives at your door' and one button. Homepage, Prints, exhibition and artist pages: Discover the prints. Artwork page: Order a print of <that work>.

• The loop plays only while on screen; a still with reduced motion.

files.text:
Files (Desktop › print-arrives)

• print-arrives-full.mp4: 21 s, no sound, 1024 × 576, 3 MB. Loaded only when opened.

• print-arrives-preview.mp4 + .webm: the first second, 40–55 KB. Use these for the circle.

• print-arrives-thumb.gif: the same second as a GIF, ~950 KB. Only where video can't play (emails).

• print-arrives-poster.jpg: the first frame, before the loop starts.
